decisions.text: behaviour: the live 'now' chip is shown only when the chosen date is today on the server's clock; on another date the first strip time is selected — reverse: change `chosen_` in floor-view.component.ts
behaviour: stripTimes lists each range up to, not including, its close, and flags times after midnight with nextDay — reverse: change the loop bound in stripTimes

behaviour: the floor-map `details` input shows the state label, name and time as text on the table; the table's own name read 'number · label · name time' — reverse: stop passing `details` from the floor view
behaviour: after a successful mode switch the profile store is updated by setConfirmMode of plan 667, not reloaded from the server — reverse: call profileData.reloadFromStorage() after the write
behaviour: the plan's 'seated' rule was read as: a live seated booking counts even when over its end, with `over_time` winning first — reverse: change the order in tableStatesAt
seen: server/routes/bookings.js:255 already sends `now` in /day (plan 685), so only the server test was added
seen: plan 671's Reuse Check named no family for app-floor-map; I rewrote those rows in the plan file to name floor-map and declared the new scoped classes, which kit-checks required

behaviour: a refused move is recognised by the server's 409 codes NO_TABLE, BAD_STATUS and STATUS_CHANGED, because BookingResult carries no HTTP status (the service is outside this plan's scope). Any other failure ends move mode with rq_decision_failed — reverse: expose the HTTP status in BookingDataService.run and test for 409.
behaviour: the sheet takes one extra input, look (the table state from tableStatesAt), instead of recomputing the hold minutes itself — reverse: compute it in the sheet from the profile.
behaviour: a tap on a not-active table in normal mode opens a sheet that shows only its label (the plan says this); in move mode the same tap does nothing.
behaviour: the walk-in dialog from the bar dims tables that do not fit the party and ignores a tap on them — reverse: show all tables as tappable and let the server refuse
behaviour: the area select in the phone-booking dialog shows only when the plan has two or more areas — reverse: always show it
behaviour: the arrived and assign actions of the two lists are offered at the live moment only; at another hour the lists show without actions — reverse: always show the actions
behaviour: a walk-in 409 is read as code NO_TABLE (the server's answer for a taken table) and shows wlk_table_taken — reverse: map another code in walk-in-dialog onSeat
behaviour: with a client picked in the phone-booking dialog the new-guest fields are hidden — reverse: always show them
behaviour: the not-assigned panel is hidden when the day has no such booking, so its empty message never shows on the floor view — reverse: always show the panel
behaviour: dialog bodies and list stacks use the engine .c-input-stack class instead of their own CSS, to pass the kit duplicate-style check — reverse: give each its own flex-column rule
behaviour: the two lists share one stylesheet (arriving-list.component.scss) and the planned unassigned-list.component.scss was dropped — reverse: copy the file back
behaviour: a staff e2e check (672-2) changes the role by editing loggedInUser in sessionStorage with an init script — reverse: stub the user another way
seen: src/testing/test-lucide-icons.ts has no Phone icon, so the floor-view specs add Phone to their own pick (that file is outside this plan's scope)

behaviour: a phone typed in the add form needs at least 7 digits, like the walk-in dialog, so seating cannot fail later on the client lookup — reverse: drop MIN_PHONE_DIGITS in waitlist-drawer.component.ts
behaviour: the waiting rows use a local .wl-row list, not .c-list-row (display: contents cannot lay out a single line); no new .c-* class — reverse: switch the rows to a list-shell grid
behaviour: quoted minutes is a digits-only text field (0–240), because the reuse lint refuses a bare type=number input — reverse: wrap a type=number input in appNumberBox
behaviour: a 409 BAD_STATUS or STATUS_CHANGED while seating ends the pick-a-table mode, shows bk_bad_status and reloads; NO_TABLE keeps the mode — reverse: keep the mode for all 409s
behaviour: on a phone the row action text is hidden (icons with aria-labels only), as the plan's layout says — reverse: remove the display:none in the phone media query
